legs.P5: Mira's stored Widgets.layout still pinned the widget to top; the room had no apps drawer and no widget iframe; the room header labels were Open room settings, Room info, Video call, Voice call, Threads, Room info, 2 members (no widget button). notes: The widget was served from a second static origin because the app's static server redirected index.html URLs; a property of the local server, not of the build.

Element renders widget iframes through a persisted element outside the right panel's DOM subtree, so the observation records the WidgetCard and the screenshot rather than an iframe inside .mx_RightPanel.
